name: Acrodysplasia Scoliosis

criteria.description: Presence of acrodysplasia characterized by abnormal bone development and shortening of distal extremities
Radiologically confirmed progressive scoliosis with vertebral anomalies
Characteristic facial features including midface hypoplasia and flattened nasal bridge
Postnatal growth retardation with short stature

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of acrodysplasia with radiologically confirmed progressive scoliosis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not mandatory

laboratory: Possible mild elevation of bone turnover markers
imaging: X-ray showing acrodysplastic shortening of distal bones
Spinal radiographs demonstrating progressive scoliosis and vertebral anomalies
Thoracic cage deformities on chest imaging
genetic: Mutations in genes associated with skeletal dysplasia (specific gene not well defined)
other: Clinical observation of characteristic facial dysmorphism
Growth charts indicating postnatal growth retardation

distinguishingFeatures: Rhizomelic limb shortening rather than distal
No progressive scoliosis with vertebral malformations
Involvement of epiphyses and spine with short trunk dwarfism

redFlags: Rapid progression of scoliosis causing respiratory compromise
Neurological deficits indicating spinal cord compression
Severe thoracic deformity impairing cardiopulmonary function
references: Recent literature on acrodysplasia and scoliosis syndromes
